records.title: NativeTernary: A Self-Delimiting Binary Encoding with Unary Run-Length Hierarchy Markers for Ternary Neural Network Weights, Structured Data, and General Computing Infrastructure
records.reason: NativeTernary encodes ternary weights and structure; a BitNet b1.58 2B example estimates 91-byte boundary metadata vs about 42KB GGUF headers. Benchmarks are assumption-based/single-core synthetic, with checkpoint validation planned. It reduces format/header overhead, not inference compute/runtime memory; weak serving relation.

records.title: The Impact of LLM Self-Consistency and Reasoning Effort on Automated Scoring Accuracy and Cost
records.reason: Study compares self-consistency and reasoning effort for high-school math conversational scoring. Estimated per-1,000-call API cost shows higher reasoning does not consistently improve accuracy but increases cost; lower-cost/no-reasoning models are near-frontier. This is a narrow application cost/configuration study, not a new inference technique; pricing/results are cross-sectional.
